preReview.title: Sorensen: Vancouver cannot 'flip a coin' against Chicago
preReview.description: Jesper Sorensen felt his Vancouver Whitecaps team played with too much risk in their 3-3 draw with D.C. United last time out in MLS.

preReview.description: Secondo Jesper Sorensen, i Vancouver Whitecaps hanno corso troppi rischi nel 3-3 contro il D.C. United nell'ultima gara di MLS.

preReview.description: Jesper Sorensen avaliou que o Vancouver Whitecaps se expôs demais no empate por 3 a 3 com o D.C. United pela MLS.

preReview.title: Sorensen : Vancouver ne peut pas « jouer à quitte ou double » contre Chicago
preReview.description: Jesper Sorensen estime que ses Vancouver Whitecaps ont pris trop de risques lors du nul 3-3 face à D.C. United en MLS.

preReview.title: سورنسن: لا مجال أمام فانكوفر للمجازفة ضد شيكاغو
